Package org.apache.hadoop.yarn.server.router

Class RouterMetrics

java.lang.Object
org.apache.hadoop.yarn.server.router.RouterMetrics
@Private @Metrics(about="Metrics for Router Federation Interceptor", context="fedr") public final class RouterMetrics extends Object
This class is for maintaining the various Router Federation Interceptor activity statistics and publishing them through the metrics interfaces.
